compile.level_resolved_intra: N and the intra part of Hc are not constant on Hamming weight. They need an 8-level diagonal on each cavity, not the 4-phase shell. M and K and Hc_inter are two-body and can share one compiled inter profile once the shared thetas are fixed. This is not claimed to cost the same as native Hc.
compile.shell: 3 relative Hamming phases per layer, shared across cavities
